items.a: A small, polished tip button you drop onto your own website, so your supporters can pay without leaving your page.

items.q: Do I need a separate account or page for my visitors?
items.a: No. The button works right on your site. There is an optional hosted page for people who prefer one, but you do not need it.

items.q: How is this different from the tipping tools I already know?
items.a: Most tools send your visitors over to someone else's page. QuietJar keeps them on yours. Fewer steps, no drop-off, more of them actually follow through.

items.q: Will it slow down my site?
items.a: No. QuietJar is built to be fast. It loads lightly and does not weigh your page down.
There is no monthly fee and no plans to compare. QuietJar takes a small share of what you actually receive, so it costs you nothing until it earns you something.

items.q: What payment methods can my supporters use?
items.a: The ones people actually reach for. Apple Pay, cards, and other common options, right where they already pay. Paying feels effortless.

items.q: What happens after someone supports me?
items.a: QuietJar steps back. It stops pestering people who have already given, so your biggest supporters get thanked instead of nagged.

items.q: How do I add it to my site?
items.a: Paste a small piece of code, pick your design, and it is live. It takes minutes, and it fits the look of your page.

cta.title: Stop losing supporters on the way to the checkout.
cta.description: Add the button to your site in minutes. No monthly fee. No redirects. Just a quiet, polished way for your people to support you.
